answers: What is this source record about?
rules: Use the existing domain and topic system for regional climate and disaster-risk policy documentation. A sector topic does not expand this tracker into a general development assessment.

The model selects topic IDs only. Each source record has one primary_topic_id when a listed topic fits, optional secondary_topic_ids, and unmapped_concepts otherwise. Domains and display groups are derived by code.

Select only topics substantively supported by the record. Mere mentions do not justify tags. Unknown or unmapped concepts stay visible as unmapped evidence with their original statement_type; never invent a topic ID.
home_domain_id explicitly fixes the topic's scoring home and Stage 2 owner. Placements control display only; their order never changes the home. Every topic has at most one group per domain.
A topic may appear in several domain views. Its comparison-band count contributes only to home_domain_id. Secondary displays are cross-links and do not create another topic or claim score.

The primary_topic_id gives a record its canonical stage-2 topic owner. Consolidation may batch topics by their home domain. Secondary tags may pull read-only supporting context into another topic pack; they never create a second claim owner.
Claim topics describe the main proposition. Supporting and contextual evidence keeps its own labels and must not automatically upgrade the claim's implementation stage.

An ID is never reused for a different meaning. Preserve IDs for label and organizational changes; prefixes remain historical identifiers. Semantic splits or mergers need explicit lineage to successor IDs.
Use a sector topic for a sector measure (flood defences = WAT-03). Use a Disaster Risk Management topic only when the subject is the cross-sector disaster-risk system itself.
Membership of the Climate domain does not establish climate causation; an earthquake is never climate evidence.

The default comparison profile includes all 64 topics in this version, each with one scoring home. Smaller focus filters change display only. Any narrower regional profile must be versioned and shared by all countries in that comparison.
Missing evidence is not proof of policy absence or non-applicability. Never remove a topic from one country's comparison denominator because the uploaded documents are silent.
Preserve relevant unmapped climate/disaster assertions with primary_topic_id null, original statement_type and source quotes; do not create an Other domain or add topics automatically.
Each secondary topic needs source-qualified evidence for that subject and any claimed response/delivery detail. A claim-wide band is not automatically inherited by all tags.
Explicit document priorities are a source-grounded navigation lens only. Priority needs and priority responses remain distinguishable. The lens does not change comparison denominators.
Broad sector definitions do not authorize unrelated general development extraction. Keep relevant cross-cutting climate/disaster concepts even when no current topic fits.

domains.label: Climate
domains.definition: Climate-specific cross-sector policy: governance, finance, transparency, economy-wide mitigation, climate information and loss and damage. Sector measures use their sector domain.

domains.label: Disaster Risk Management
domains.definition: All-hazards disaster-risk systems: governance, risk knowledge, warning and preparedness, response, recovery and risk finance, whether or not the hazard is climate-related.

domains.label: Agriculture & Food
domains.definition: Crops, soils, livestock, rangelands, farm water, fisheries and food systems.

domains.label: Water
domains.definition: Water resources, supply, basins, drought, floods and coasts, water quality and the cryosphere as a water source.

domains.label: Nature, Forests & Land
domains.definition: Forests, land, land degradation, biodiversity, ecosystems and land carbon.

domains.label: Energy
domains.definition: Energy supply, renewables, grids, efficiency, heating, fossil-fuel transition and methane.

domains.label: Settlements & Infrastructure
domains.definition: Buildings, settlements, land-use planning, urban heat and critical infrastructure. Membership does not establish urban geographic scope.

domains.label: Transport
domains.definition: Vehicles, fuels, mobility services and transport-network resilience.

domains.label: Industry & Mining
domains.definition: Industrial production, processes, industrial resilience, mining and extractives.

domains.label: Health
domains.definition: Climate- and disaster-related health risks and health services.

domains.label: Waste & Circular Economy
domains.definition: Materials and recycling, solid waste and landfill methane, wastewater.

domains.label: Economy & Transition
domains.definition: Economic diversification, economic resilience, just transition and restructuring of climate-exposed or fossil-dependent economies.

domains.label: Livelihoods & Social Protection

domains.label: Culture & Heritage
domains.definition: Tangible and intangible heritage and local or traditional knowledge.

domains.label: Education & Knowledge
domains.definition: Education, public awareness, research, data and knowledge systems.

domains.label: Tourism

proposal_metadata.scope: National policy documentation on regional climate action and all-hazards disaster risk; sector topics stay within this scope.

change_log.reason: The draft names the optional hazard label field and keeps risk evidence separate from warning actions.
One topic has one display group per domain. Topic definition and cross-domain placements are unchanged.
One topic has one display group per domain. Topic definition and cross-domain placements are unchanged.
A shared topic or claim may appear in several views, but has one canonical owner and one scoring home.
Initialize from the existing first placement, then separate analytical ownership from future display ordering.
Unknown topic assignment must not erase commitments, concerns or other original assertion types.
Secondary labels and cross-domain views must not import unrelated delivery evidence or duplicate counts.
Regional prioritization remains source-grounded; source-role mismatch stays visible rather than affecting inferred policy quality.

ownership_policy.claim_scoring_home: primary_topic_id_for_identity; source-qualified secondary topics may independently establish their topic band
ownership_policy.secondary_topic_evidence: Each secondary topic requires its own source-qualified evidence predicate and compatible response/delivery detail. Do not copy a claim band to every tag. Record topic-to-evidence provenance; a display placement, supports link or unrelated actor never establishes qualification.

comparison_policy.source_role_rule: Like-for-like comparison uses the same configured NDC/NAP role set and edition/date rules. NDC-only and NDC-plus-NAP are different profiles. All supplied material is exploratory when no common profile is satisfied.
comparison_policy.priority_lens: Source-explicit priority filter changes visible evidence only; no model ranking, topic exclusion or score weighting.
